editorial.blurb: A neighborhood Chinese spot serving up fresh, crunchy spring rolls and standout orange chicken that keeps people coming back—though some longtime fans note portions and seasoning have shifted over time.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the shrimp with broccoli or orange chicken for consistently reliable hits; the food comes out fast, making it ideal for takeout. Just note that some dishes run salty, so you may want to request less soy sauce.
